chaoskick.name: Chaos Kick
chaoskick.desc: The user kicks the target to tear down all they've built. Removes all of the target's stat changes.

bombboom.name: BombBoom
bombboom.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing a small explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

dragondash.name: Dragon Dash
dragondash.desc: The user dashes and strikes the target with draconic energy. This move always goes first.

dragonfang.name: Dragon Fang
dragonfang.desc: The target is bitten with draconic fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

heavyimpact.name: Heavy Impact
heavyimpact.desc: The user slams its heavy body into the target at full force to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may make the target flinch.

divinedragonlight.name: Divine Dragon Light
divinedragonlight.desc: The divine dragon's light blinds the foe, causing their next move to fail and leaving them confused.

wallbomb.name: Wall Bomb
wallbomb.desc: The user summons a Wall, exploding next turn, hits through immunities

realitybreak.name: Reality Break
realitybreak.desc: The user bewilders the target with a reality-bending illusion, and strikes a vicious blow. This attack deals double damage if the target is confused.

primalguard.name: Primal Guard
primalguard.desc: The user protects itself and raises Def by one stage.

work.name: Work
work.desc: The type of the move varies with the secondary typing of the user, has a chance to flinch

dragonsfist.name: Dragon's Fist
dragonsfist.desc: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.desc: The user locks itself in place to become solid as a fortress, sharply boosting its Defense and Sp. Def but lowering its Speed. The user can’t flee or switch out after using this move.

soakup.name: Soak Up
soakup.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in rain.

phantomsurge.name: Phantom Surge
phantomsurge.desc: The user focuses it's powers to send a blast and quickly switches out of combat

hypnoblast.name: Hypnoblast
hypnoblast.desc: The user attacks the target with great psychic power. However, this also lowers the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

clanroar.name: Clan Roar
clanroar.desc: A fierce rallying cry that raises the Attack of the user's entire clan.

diamonddrill.name: Diamond Drill
diamonddrill.desc: The user launches itself at the opponent with drill like movements. This move does extra damage to ground types.

ragingdragon.name: Raging Dragon
ragingdragon.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

arachnoclasp.name: Arachno Clasp
arachnoclasp.desc: The target is attacked by multiple claws. This move may cause flinch and changes type based on the gear equipped.

sinisterplan.name: Sinister Plan
sinisterplan.desc: The user comes up with a sinister plan to boost its Sp. Atk and Defense stats. In void fog, it boosts its Sp. Atk sharply.

ram.name: Ram
ram.desc: The user rams 1-3 times, each has a chance to lower def

goldrush.name: Gold Rush
goldrush.desc: The user shoots a barrage of coins at the target, hoping to get lucky. This move hits the target one to ten times in a row, and has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit, but the attack ends if the user misses.

aurastorm.name: Aura Storm
aurastorm.desc: The user lets loose a surge of aura power from deep within its body at the target. The recoil from this move lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. This attack never misses.

gmaxcountdown.name: G-Max Countdown
gmaxcountdown.desc: A Fairy-type attack that Gigantamax Jesteratus use. This move twists the dimensions, in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

royalflare.name: Royal Flare
royalflare.desc: The user scorches the target with an intense flame. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user. If this move is a Physical attack, it deals special damage. If this move is a Special attack, it deals physical damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.

hotair.name: Hot Air
hotair.desc: The user blows heated air towards the opposing Pokémon. In harsh sunlight, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the target with a burn.

armorpress.name: Armor Press
armorpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its armored body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

venomtackle.name: Venom Tackle
venomtackle.desc: The user hits its target with reckless power, it also damages the user with recoil

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.desc: The power of this attack move is doubled if it's used on a target that's switching out of battle.

fluffyfable.name: Fluffy Fable
fluffyfable.desc: The user begins an exaggerated heroic tale, becoming untouchable for a turn before striking with dramatic force. Raises the user's Speed after landing.

moltenbomb.name: Molten Bomb
moltenbomb.desc: Inflicts damage based on the target's Defense, not Special Defense.

eeriedance.name: Eerie Dance
eeriedance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, unsettling dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.desc: The user whips up a typhoon to attack the target. In rain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

hopesend.name: Hope's End
hopesend.desc: The user lands a devastating blow that tarnishes the target's resolve. This move deals special damage and may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

turntail.name: Turn Tail
turntail.desc: The user cowardly rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting, restoring its own HP by up to one third its max HP.

venomousembrace.name: Venomous Embrace
venomousembrace.desc: The user ensnares the target with toxic ribbons, poisoning the defender and trapping them until the user is taken down or switches out.

pageturn.name: Page Turn
pageturn.desc: The user turns a page of its spell book. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats. When used by Wizledger it changes form.

starfirebreath.name: Starfire Breath
starfirebreath.desc: The user fires of a powerful beam of concentrated arcane power as scorching as the stars themselves. This may burn the target.

surpriseslam.name: Surprise Slam
surpriseslam.desc: The user strikes with sinister force. May cause the target to flinch or become paralyzed.

terrabite.name: Terra Bite
terrabite.desc: The user viciously bites the target to hold them in place. The target becomes unable to flee.

rustingwater.name: Rusting Water
rustingwater.desc: The user shoots a beam of salty water at the target. Super-effective against Steel type Pokémon.

enchantedroom.name: Enchanted Room
enchantedroom.desc: For 5 turns, all Pokemon's held items have no effect.

witheringstab.name: Withering Stab
witheringstab.desc: The user stabs the target, withering their defences and bypassing blocks

aquabomb.name: Aqua Bomb
aquabomb.desc: Inflicts damage based on the target's Special Defense, not Defense.

stormsiphon.name: Storm Siphon
stormsiphon.desc: The user draws in lightning to restore its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather and terrain.

rainbloom.name: Rain Bloom
rainbloom.desc: The user attacks the target with a blooming flower. This move's power is boosted by 50% and the user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target in heavy rain.

alluringaroma.name: Alluring Aroma
alluringaroma.desc: The user draws attention to itself by releasing a sweet-smelling perfume, making all targets take aim only at the user. Poison-type Pokémon are immune to this effect.

apexsplash.name: Apex Splash
apexsplash.desc: The apex of all splashes. Strikes the target 2–5 times with unpredictable force, each hit carrying potential to disrupt Speed.

plague.name: Plague
plague.desc: Badly poisons the target and lowers its Speed by 1.

rageshot.name: Rage Shot
rageshot.desc: The users shoots a barrage against the foe, 1-10 hits based on the user frustration

stealbeam.name: Steal Beam
stealbeam.desc: Steals the target's held item if the user has none.

quantumsingularity.name: Quantum Singularity
quantumsingularity.desc: Distorts space-time and traps the target in a gravitational loop, damaging them for several turns.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: The user enters in rampage unable to use other moves and getting stronger each use, the user only stops when it misses

perching.name: Perching
perching.desc: The user perches onto the ground after a long flight, restoring the user's HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP when landing after using the move Take-Off.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.desc: The user maximizes its Sp. Atk stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

lockin.name: Lock In
lockin.desc: The user shakes off their nerves to face the battle ahead. This move boosts the user's Attack, Defense, and Sp. Def stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

gholdenparade.name: Gholden Parade
gholdenparade.desc: Hits all targets, coins drop 100x the Pokémons level. Boosts the users Sp. Attack by two stages.

bansheescream.name: Banshee Scream
bansheescream.desc: The user attacks by letting loose a soul-shattering cry, which may lower the target's Attack.

treefell.name: Tree Fell
treefell.desc: The user attacks by hacking at the target with a blade. This move is super effective on Grass-type Pokémon.

grandduel.name: Grand Duel
grandduel.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

potshot.name: Potshot
potshot.desc: The user fires a quick shot at the unsuspecting target. This move usually goes first and has a heightened chance of landing a critical-hit, but isn't always an accurate shot.

nightterror.name: Night Terror
nightterror.desc: The user devours the dreams of a sleeping target, leaving behind nothing but nightmares. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

sacredarrow.name: Sacred Arrow
sacredarrow.desc: The user fires an arrow made of blazing light energy at the target, hindering it from healing from any source for 3 turns.

radiantdescent.name: Radiant Descent
radiantdescent.desc: User calls upon dark energy to descend from the skies, striking the foe, lowering its Defense and Special Defense.

fleurdance.name: Fleur Dance
fleurdance.desc: The user performs an elegant flowery dance to strike the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

riseabove.name: Rise Above
riseabove.desc: The user rises above its limits to gather energy on the first turn, then boosts its Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed on the next turn.

glacialcrash.name: Glacial Crash
glacialcrash.desc: The user attacks by slamming its icy body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

dualhoof.name: Dual Hoof
dualhoof.desc: The user shoots high preasure water from it's back hooves at the opponent. This move does extra damage to dark types and hits twice.

bugnoise.name: Bug Noise
bugnoise.desc: 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

stoneage.name: Stone Age
stoneage.desc: A column of stone hits the target. It has a unique effect when used alongside Ice Age, Iron Age, Dragon Age, or Electric Age. The effect changes depending on which move its combined with.

overload.name: Overload
overload.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing a massive explosion of electricity. The user faints upon using this move and leaves a Electric Terrain.

neutronblast.name: Neutron Blast
neutronblast.desc: Hits 3 times. Raises Speed but lowers Defense.

psyclone.name: Psyclone
psyclone.desc: The user employs its power to attack by wrapping its opponent in a fierce psychic wind. This may also confuse the target.

chaosmaxcannon.name: Chaos MAX Cannon
chaosmaxcannon.desc: A devastating blast that ignores defenses and abilities.

whimsicalgallop.name: Whimsical Gallop
whimsicalgallop.desc: A playful magical dash that may flinch the foe and restores a bit of HP to the user.

triplebite.name: Triple Bite
triplebite.desc: The user fiercerly bites the target three times then switches out. Always hit first

zekromkick.name: Zekrom Kick
zekromkick.desc: The user delivers a powerful Zekrom Kick! This move is Dragon and Electric type simultaneously. This may also make the target flinch.

jackalopeswhistle.name: Jackalope's Whistle
jackalopeswhistle.desc: The user lets out a feint whistle. Any opponent that hears it will have their attacking stats raised tremendously, but have their defensive stats lowered tremendously.

nightmarch.name: Night March
nightmarch.desc: The user calls its fallen allies to aid in attacking the target. The number of hits the move has matches the number of defeated allies there are in the user's party.

boulderbash.name: Boulder Bash
boulderbash.desc: The user bashes the target with rough chunks of rock.

soulfireblade.name: Soulfire Blade
soulfireblade.desc: The user slashes the target with a blade of soulfire. This may leave the target with a burn.

fester.name: Fester
fester.desc: The user feasts on the target's natural energies. This move always hits and raises Attack if the target is a Psychic, Dark or Grass-type.

shadowstars.name: Shadow Stars
shadowstars.desc: The user attacks by shooting dark throwing stars at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

apexacidfang.name: Apex Acid Fang
apexacidfang.desc: A fusion of Acid Spray and Poison Fang. Has a 70% chance to poison and lowers the target's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

psychoforce.name: Psycho Force
psychoforce.desc: The user fills the surrounding air with psychic energy and crushes any pokemon within it's range. This move is super effective against Bug types and may cause confusion.

abyssdash.name: Abyss Dash
abyssdash.desc: The user charges it's speed for a turn, later unleashing a ultra sonic tackle

arcflash.name: Arc Flash
arcflash.desc: The user charges at the target while cloaked in eletric arcs. This attack has a chance to burn.

breezeball.name: Breeze Ball
breezeball.desc: The user hurls a wind charge at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

dragonpress.name: Dragon Press
dragonpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

synapseflare.name: Synapse Flare
synapseflare.desc: Unleashes a powerful psychic wave at full processor output. Hits through Protect and Substitute. One of the user's stats is randomly lowered after use.

dragonmirror.name: Dragon Mirror
dragonmirror.desc: Protects the user and boosts Special Attack.

wonderblast.name: Wonder Blast
wonderblast.desc: The user attacks the target with a bizarre power. The target becomes confused and this move's power is boosted by 50% when Wonder Room is active.

dualdroneslash.name: Dual Droneslash
dualdroneslash.desc: The user uses it's propeller to launch wave like slashes towards the opponent. This move hits twice.

machbolt.name: Mach Bolt
machbolt.desc: The user shoots a bolt of electricity at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

honeybomb.name: Honey Bomb
honeybomb.desc: The user fires a ball of honey at the target. The more honey is gathered, the greater the move's power. This also lowers the user's speed.

pollenburst.name: Pollen Burst
pollenburst.desc: The user bursts it's pollen, lowering the speed of all targets

slickslime.name: Slick Slime
slickslime.desc: The user coats itself in a slippery slime that increases it Sp. Def and prevents it from being trapped or bound by moves. This also prevents the user's speed from being lowered by the opponent's attacks.

guardcoat.name: Guard Coat
guardcoat.desc: The user attacks by slamming its fluffy body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals. This move's effects vary depending on what trim the user has.

boostervolt.name: Booster Volt
boostervolt.desc: The target is blasted with intense Electricity from Iron Flux's back booster, raising Sp. Atk in electric terrain one stage.

limitbreak.name: Limit Break
limitbreak.desc: The user pushes its limits to attack the target. The more the target's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

tidalwave.name: Tidal Wave
tidalwave.desc: The user attacks the target with a giant wave. When Gravity is active, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

centifuge.name: Centifuge
centifuge.desc: The user attacks by wrapping its long body around the target to lock them in place, preventing them from fleeing. This move also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

apexpoisonsmokescreen.name: Apex Poison Smokescreen
apexpoisonsmokescreen.desc: The apex version combining Poison Gas and Smokescreen. Poisons all adjacent foes and lowers their accuracy by 1 stage.

burststreamofdestruction.name: Burst Stream of Destruction
burststreamofdestruction.desc: Unleashes raw annihilation. The user must recharge the next turn.

mossthrow.name: Moss Throw
mossthrow.desc: The user throws a moss at the target

electrojam.name: Electro Jam
electrojam.desc: The user fires out an ECM blast that lowers the special stats of all pokemon.

cry.name: Cry
cry.desc: Sound move. Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

chillowisp.name: Chill-O-Wisp
chillowisp.desc: The user shoots chilling ice energy at the target to lower SpAtk and Spe by 1 stage.

seamitarslash.name: Seamitar Slash
seamitarslash.desc: The user strikes using hidden blades, slashing faster than the blink of an eye. This move never misses and has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This move also deals physical damage.

gmaxbizarre.name: G-Max Bizarre
gmaxbizarre.desc: A Psychic-type attack that Gigantamax Cephcery use. This move makes opponents only able to use attacking moves for a short time.

dazzledash.name: Dazzle Dash
dazzledash.desc: The user dashes and dazzles the target with mystical energy. This move always goes first.

trinityobliteration.name: Trinity Obliteration
trinityobliteration.desc: If it hits, all opposing Pokémon faint. If it misses, the user faints.

mantisstrike.name: Mantis Strike
mantisstrike.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

darkeningbolt.name: Darkening Bolt
darkeningbolt.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.

systempurge.name: System Purge
systempurge.desc: Purges corrupted system status and sends the thermal feedback to the opponent, always burning them.

conjuringfire.name: Conjuring Fire
conjuringfire.desc: The user burns its item in order to cast a fiery spell. This move's effects change depending on the user's held item. The item is consumed after use. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

dragoniceblaze.name: Dragon-Ice Blaze
dragoniceblaze.desc: Dragon-type special move. 110 power. Sets Hail. 50% chance to freeze or burn the target.

rootout.name: Root Out
rootout.desc: The user goes all out and attacks the target by tearing its own roots out of the ground. This lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats. This also increases in power if the user is ingrained, but they uproot themselves in the process.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.desc: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. The user's HP will be restored by a portion of the damage dealt. If the user is at full hp, instead of healing it will summon grassy terrain.

fairytail.name: Fairy Tail
fairytail.desc: The user attacks the target with a magical tail. The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

flashfreezeheatwave.name: Flashfreeze Heatwave
flashfreezeheatwave.desc: The user erupts in an explosion of heat and cold with 30% chance to burn or freeze the target. This move counts as both a Fire and Ice type move.

tripletumble.name: Triple Tumble
tripletumble.desc: The user stumbles around crashing into the target. This hits three times and becomes more powerful with each successful hit, but randomly lowers the user's Attack, Defense, or Speed stats for each hit.

radioblast.name: Radio Blast
radioblast.desc: The user beams the target with high power radio waves. This lowers the users special attack.

asphyxiate.name: Asphyxiate
asphyxiate.desc: The user attacks by drawing in the air from the target. This move also lifts the effects of Tailwind from the opposing side. Also prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

slipstream.name: Slipstream
slipstream.desc: The user creates a slipstream and dashes at the target with high speed. This increases the user's Speed.

steelblade.name: Steel Blade
steelblade.desc: The user slices the target with a blade as sharp as steel. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

rainbowwing.name: Rainbow Wing
rainbowwing.desc: The user attacks by showering the target with rainbow feathers. If its raining this move makes the weather sunny and creates a rainbow above your team's side. This doesn't work in heavy rain however.

bygonebash.name: Bygone Bash
bygonebash.desc: The user throws a mighty punch using combined power of the spirits of its ancestors. This also damages the user quite a lot.

warble.name: Warble
warble.desc: Sound move. 20% chance to confuse the target.

sneakattack.name: Sneak Attack
sneakattack.desc: The user sneaks up and swiftly strikes the target. This move always goes first.

eldereye.name: Elder Eye
eldereye.desc: The user fires a crystalline beam of energy at the target. In rain, it also electrifies the target's next move.

feyblade.name: Fey Blade
feyblade.desc: The user slashes the target using a magical key as a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

rapidfire.name: Rapid Fire
rapidfire.desc: The user fires three sand projectiles in quick succession. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit, and may burn and flinch the target.

jab.name: Jab
jab.desc: The user makes a jab, often flinching the target

flapaway.name: Flap Away
flapaway.desc: The user quickly flees from the battle, lowering the foes Speed and Attack stat

northwind.name: North Wind
northwind.desc: The user blows a freezing tempest towards the opposing Pokémon. In snow or hail, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

boosterburn.name: Booster Burn
boosterburn.desc: The target is blasted with intense heat from Iron Flare's back booster, raising Sp. Atk in electric terrain one stage.

shiftingsands.name: Shifting Sands
shiftingsands.desc: The user shifts the sand in battlefield before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

starshower.name: Starshower
starshower.desc: The user attacks by showering the target with stars. This move hits two to five times in a row. This move also does increased damage if the user has used Cosmic Power previously.

psychocrash.name: Psycho Crash
psychocrash.desc: The user unleashes its pent up psychic power to attack everything around it. This leaves the targets confused, but prevents the user from moving on the next turn.

apexcannon.name: Apex Cannon
apexcannon.desc: A devastating beam that overloads the user’s system. Can only be used once per battle. Deals 20% recoil.

groundbreak.name: Ground Break
groundbreak.desc: The user hits its target with massive power, often breaking their defense and making them more vulnerable

crystalconstrict.name: Crystal Constrict
crystalconstrict.desc: The user shackles the target with a chain made of ice crystals and prevents it from switching out.

energyshot.name: Energy Shot
energyshot.desc: Shoots a energy ball full of electricity

gamble.name: Gamble
gamble.desc: Gambles to receive a random amount of emeralds to be thrown into the enemy

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.desc: The user fires a beam of sunlight at the target to inflict damage. This move's power is boosted by 50% in harsh sunlight, and may also leave the target with a burn.

voltshot.name: Volt Shot
voltshot.desc: The user send a high voltage shot to the target

rootribble.name: Root Ribble
rootribble.desc: The user uses it's roots to attack all targets

takeoff.name: Take-Off
takeoff.desc: The user strikes the target and takes off into the air. This causes the user to float in the air, giving them immunity to Ground-type moves. This move fails if the user already used Take-Off previously.

startlingshriek.name: Startling Shriek
startlingshriek.desc: The user jumps out of its hiding place and shrieks loudly to startle the opposing team. This lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats, but it only works on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

dragontrap.name: Dragon Trap
dragontrap.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying a special attack.

twilightveil.name: Twilight Veil
twilightveil.desc: The user calls upon the Moon for help, using 1/5 of their Max HP to reduce damage from physical and special moves for five turns. Has no recoil when used under Misty Terrian.

finalchorus.name: Final Chorus
finalchorus.desc: The user sings a final farewell before fainting. In return, all Pokémon on the field with the Poison or Toxic status will also faint.

stonecoldstare.name: Stone Cold Stare
stonecoldstare.desc: The user stares into the target’s eyes, briefly turning them to stone.

ironfang.name: Iron Fang
ironfang.desc: The user bites with sharp metal fangs. This may also make the target flinch or lower the target's Defense stat.

guroball.name: Guro Ball
guroball.desc: Bullet move. 30% chance to poison the target.

puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
puppeteer.desc: The user shackles the target with ghostly strings and controls them like a puppet. This confuses the target and compels them to keep using the move it last used.

corruption.name: Corruption
corruption.desc: The user corrupts the mind of the target and changes their type to Dark.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.desc: The user digs it's roots into the target, locking them both in place. This move is super effective on Steel types.

popup.name: Pop Up
popup.desc: The user puffs up its body to shoot toxic shrapnel at the target. This move makes the target flinch and inflicts the target with poison, but it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

atroposcut.name: Atropos' Cut
atroposcut.desc: The user cuts the foe’s thread of life with unerring precision. This attack always lands a critical hit and targets the foe’s Defense rather than Special Defense.

ironvaliance.name: Iron Valiance
ironvaliance.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

psychoburst.name: Psycho Burst
psychoburst.desc: The user condenses it's psychic power and releases it in a quick burst. This move is super effective against Dark types and has the ability to switch between its attack stats depending on which is stronger.

hammerdown.name: Hammer Down
hammerdown.desc: The user launches a rock into the air with its mighty hammer. Flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when they're hit. This move is also super effective on Steel types.

psykick.name: Psy-Kick
psykick.desc: The user attacks by jumping into the air and striking with a psychic-enhanced kick. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

dragonroar.name: Dragon Roar
dragonroar.desc: Forces the target to switch out. Lowers its Attack.

choppingblock.name: Chopping Block
choppingblock.desc: The user slashes the opponent with an Axe-like blade. This move has a heightened critical hit chance, and is unaffected by the target’s stats.

starbit.name: Starbit
starbit.desc: The user fires speedy shooting star at the opponent. This move always goes first.

warmwelcome.name: Warm Welcome
warmwelcome.desc: The user hugs the target, overwhelming it, lowering it's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

supernova.name: Supernova
supernova.desc: The user attacks everything around it with a burst of cosmic energy and faints upon using this move. This move's power is increased on Psychic Terrain.

draconicgenesis.name: Draconic Genesis
draconicgenesis.desc: Dragon-type special move. 100 power. Sets Sunny Day & Electric Terrain. 30% chance to raise the user’s Special Attack & Special Defense by 1 stage.

skimmerslam.name: Skimmer Slam
skimmerslam.desc: The user slams into the target, this may raise the users speed.

midnightmadness.name: Midnight Madness
midnightmadness.desc: The user sends the mind of the target into brief madness. Will confuse the target.

electricage.name: Electric Age
electricage.desc: A column of electricity hits the target. It has a unique effect when used alongside Ice Age, Iron Age, Stone Age, or Dragon Age. The effect changes depending on which move its combined with.

holdtheline.name: Hold the Line
holdtheline.desc: The user rallies their troops to stand their ground and sharply boosts their Defense and Sp. Def. This prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

guardpress.name: Guard Press
guardpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its stone body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

abyssalpower.name: Abyssal Power
abyssalpower.desc: This move's type effectiveness is reversed, dealing super effective damage against targets that resist it, and not very effective damage against targets that are weak to it. This move also inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

springfling.name: Spring Fling
springfling.desc: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

extinguish.name: Extinguish
extinguish.desc: The user launches liquid into the target, extinguishing Fire-Types

formshift.name: Form Shift
formshift.desc: The user shifts its form, changing his type to steel-type

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.desc: The user whips up a swirling vortex to attack the target. This move traps the target in a whirlpool for four to five turns in rain.

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.desc: The user becomes the center of an everything devouring blackhole, attacks everyone around it with spectral energy and lowers the user's SpAtk. After this move has been used, gravity intensifies for 5 turns.

quickjolt.name: Quick Jolt
quickjolt.desc: The user fires off a small spark of jolting energy. This move always goes first.

unknownpower.name: Unknown Power
unknownpower.desc: This move is always super effective on the target if the target's type matches the user's Hidden Power type. If the target doesn't match the user's Hidden Power type, this move deals neutral damage. This move also ignores the target's immunities, and inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

frostbolt.name: Frost Bolt
frostbolt.desc: The user fires a crossbow bolt of ice at the target's weak points. This may leave the target paralyzed.

alloutacid.name: All-Out Acid
alloutacid.desc: To inflict massive damage, the user uses every ounce of poison in their body. After using this move, the user will no longer be Poison type.

triheaddestruction.name: Tri-Head Destruction
triheaddestruction.desc: Strikes 1–3 times with brutal steel force. If all three heads land a blow, the opponent is immediately annihilated.

blunderpowder.name: Blunder Powder
blunderpowder.desc: The user fires a muddy musket ball at the target. The spore powder damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

icespikes.name: Ice Spikes
icespikes.desc: The user lays a trap of ice spikes around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

gmaxpresto.name: G-Max Presto
gmaxpresto.desc: A Fairy-type attack that Gigantamax Hattertainer uses. This may also make targets flinch or leave them with a burn.

psydrive.name: Psydrive
psydrive.desc: The user delivers an powerful psychic kick to attack the target. This move deals special damage.

firebarrage.name: Fire Barrage
firebarrage.desc: The user unleashes 2-5 fireballs, each with a chance to burn the target

boxtrap.name: Box Trap
boxtrap.desc: The user hides within its shell before jumping out to bite the target the second they get too close. This move enables the user to attack first, but fails if the target is not readying an attack.

backburn.name: Backburn
backburn.desc: The user snuffs out the target with its own flames. This move is super effective on Fire-type Pokémon.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.desc: The user whips the target with high speed winds. This move always goes first and is boosted if used in Tailwind.

nosedive.name: Nosedive
nosedive.desc: The user flies into the air and dives down to attack the opponent. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

voteout.name: Vote Out
voteout.desc: The user votes out the target, forcing them to switch out.

spectralarrow.name: Spectral Arrow
spectralarrow.desc: The user shoots a spectral arrow, the hit is always critical

realitydesync.name: Reality Desync
realitydesync.desc: Distorts the opponent’s sensory field. Lowers accuracy and disables critical hits for 5 turns.

nutrientroot.name: Nutrient Root
nutrientroot.desc: Heals the user and gives a a boost to all stats, only useable when trapped

dracoblitz.name: Draco Blitz
dracoblitz.desc: The user takes 33% of the damage dealt as recoil.

sonicshriek.name: Sonic Shriek
sonicshriek.desc: The user attacks everything around it by firing a sonically-charged shriek from its chest. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

skystrike.name: Sky Strike
skystrike.desc: The user soars and clashes with the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

blazinglance.name: Blazing Lance
blazinglance.desc: The user strikes with a burning lance to avenge a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

aegisprotocol.name: Aegis Protocol
aegisprotocol.desc: A shimmering techno-barrier minimizes all damage and reflects it back at twice the force.

lightpulse.name: Light Pulse
lightpulse.desc: The user releases a shining aura imbued with light. This may also confuse the target.

toxinflood.name: Toxin Flood
toxinflood.desc: The opposing side is hit with a intense wave of poison that affects the surrounding opponents. This move may inflict poison as well as raising the users Sp. Atk by one stage.

trielementonslaught.name: Tri-Element Onslaught
trielementonslaught.desc: Dragon-type physical move. Hits 3–5 times. 20% chance per hit to burn, paralyze, or freeze the target.

powerwash.name: Power Wash
powerwash.desc: The user blasts the target with pressurized water. This may also lower the target's special defense. This move is super effective on Grass types.

chillout.name: Chill Out
chillout.desc: The user blows cold wind at the target to inflict frostbite.

fracture.name: Fracture
fracture.desc: Lowers the target speed and removes the Rock/Ice/Steel types

spectralmaul.name: Spectral Maul
spectralmaul.desc: The target's shadow is doven into, after a turn the target is mauled by a spectral figure. This move may flinch and always paralyses the target and it always breaks protect.

boltbeam.name: Bolt Beam
boltbeam.desc: The user attacks with a beam of electricity. This may also paralyze the target.

dynamodash.name: Dynamo Dash
dynamodash.desc: The user charges up and dashes at the target. Afterwards the user's Speed is increased.

apextwister.name: Apex Twister
apextwister.desc: The apex version of Twister. Hits all opponents and always causes flinching.

giantpunch.name: Giant Punch
giantpunch.desc: The user attacks the target by throwing a powerful gorilla punch. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

neuronscramble.name: Neuron Scramble
neuronscramble.desc: Overloads the opponent’s neural systems. Disables their last used move for 10 turns.

droopyhaze.name: Droopy Haze
droopyhaze.desc: The user attacks by clouding the target in a mucky mist. This attack clears all stat changes after use.

sugarcrash.name: Sugar Crash
sugarcrash.desc: The user attacks the target with sugary sweets. This may also lower the target's speed.

lunarbash.name: Lunar Bash
lunarbash.desc: the target is bashed with extreme force. This moves damage is based on the user's defensive stat.

swiftsting.name: Swift Sting
swiftsting.desc: The user lunges at the target, swiftly attacking them with their stinger. This move always goes first.

ultraspacehole.name: Ultraspace Hole
ultraspacehole.desc: The user uses portals to attack the target. This move raises Sp. Atk by one stage.

valleydrop.name: Valley Drop
valleydrop.desc: The user attacks by grabbing the target and tripping them up, causing them to fall onto their back. This lowers the target's Speed stat, but also damages the user a little.

luminbeam.name: Lumin Beam
luminbeam.desc: The target is flashed by bright lights. This attack hits twice and may paralyse.

iceage.name: Ice Age
iceage.desc: A column of ice hits the target. It has a unique effect when used alongside Iron Age, Stone Age, Dragon Age, or Electric Age. The effect changes depending on which move its combined with.

pheromania.name: Pheromania
pheromania.desc: The user emits a plethora of pheromones on the target, trapping it and lowering it's Evasion, if it is of the opposite gender.

tempestslash.name: Tempest Slash
tempestslash.desc: The target is slashed at with extreme force. This move is super effective against fairy types.

recuperation.name: Recuperation
recuperation.desc: The user slows down and begins to generate electricity, healing itself for 50% of its maximum HP and lowering its Speed.

cleansingcleave.name: Cleansing Cleave
cleansingcleave.desc: The user strikes with its blade filled with purifying energy, dealing damage and cleansing the target from its negative status ailment. If the target has a status ailment, it deals extra damage.

shulkerbullet.name: Shulker Bullet
shulkerbullet.desc: The user shoots a Shulker Bullet at the target, causing them to levitate into the air for three turns. After the effect ends, the target will crash to the ground and take damage. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.

floraltwister.name: Floral Twister
floraltwister.desc: The target is enveloped in a lush twister. This move may flinch

overclockprotocol.name: Overclock Protocol
overclockprotocol.desc: Activates the user's internal processors, causing the next attack to strike three times before the system overheats and sharply reduces all performance.

kabloom.name: Ka-Bloom
kabloom.desc: The user charges it's energy for a turn, later exploding itself

phantombloom.name: Phantom Bloom
phantombloom.desc: The user haunts the livestock around the opponent, damaging and cursing the target while also taking recoil damage. This move is super effective against Ghost types, but Ghost types are immune to the curse effect.

stoneburst.name: Stone Burst
stoneburst.desc: The user explodes, sending out shards of rock with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

shockbomb.name: Shock Bomb
shockbomb.desc: The user places a electrically charged land mine at the feet of the opposing team. The bomb will explode, destroying itself to damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

scam.name: Scam
scam.desc: Steals the target item and put it into confusion, the target gets a boost in both attacks

ultraspacefury.name: Ultraspace Fury
ultraspacefury.desc: The user uses portals to attack the target. This move lowers Def and Sp. Def while raising Sp. Atk by one stage.

gmaxlament.name: G-Max Lament
gmaxlament.desc: A Ghost-type attack that Gigantamax Plangiant use. This moves prevents opponents from restoring HP.

electronexchange.name: Electron Exchange
electronexchange.desc: The user exchanges the Electric-Type with the target, misses if neither are Electric-Type

fairyrush.name: Fairy Rush
fairyrush.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

letitcook.name: Let It Cook
letitcook.desc: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of freshly baked cookies. This harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat, and may leave the target with a burn.

noxiouschorus.name: Noxious Chorus
noxiouschorus.desc: The opposing side is affected by a intoxicating chorus. This move always inflicts poison.

nightlight.name: Nightlight
nightlight.desc: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a dark light. This may also confuse the target.

datadrain.name: Data Drain
datadrain.desc: Deals damage and randomly lowers one of the target’s stats by 1 and raises it for the user.

showdownmode.name: Showdown Mode
showdownmode.desc: The user decides to fight all out, standing on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. This raises the user's Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats for three turns, but lowers Defense and Sp. Def when those three turns run out.

emergencybloom.name: Emergency Bloom
emergencybloom.desc: The user blooms it's nature powers in emergency situations, dealing twice the amount of damage when trapped

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.desc: The user absorbs moisture with its roots, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Sharply boosts Attack and Sp. Atk in rain.

friction.name: Friction
friction.desc: The user makes friction when hitting, creating sparks on impact. This may also leave the target burned. This move is super effective on Grass types.

shiverdance.name: Shiver Dance
shiverdance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, shivering dance. This boosts the user's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. The user's Attack and Sp. Atk stat are raised sharply when its snowing.

chromacrash.name: Chroma Crash
chromacrash.desc: The user cloaks itself in wonderous fairy energy and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

dragonaxe.name: Dragon Axe
dragonaxe.desc: The user swings its axe-like tusks to attack the target. This attack leaves behind Steel splinters that can damage opponents.

zaptrap.name: Zap Trap
zaptrap.desc: The user creates a static field to protect it from attacks. This also paralyzes any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

summon.name: Summon
summon.desc: Summons a higher being that erases the entire opposing team.

bombbloom.name: Bomb Bloom
bombbloom.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing a massive explosion of leaves. The user faints upon using this move and leaves a Grassy Terrain.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.desc: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

monkeybusiness.name: Monkey Business
monkeybusiness.desc: The user trades items with the target with priority. Confuses the user if this move fails.

apexscarylook.name: Apex Scary Look
apexscarylook.desc: The apex version combining Scary Face and Mean Look. Sharply lowers the target's Speed and prevents them from escaping.

elementalvortex.name: Elemental Vortex
elementalvortex.desc: Dragon-type special move. 100 power. 15% chance to paralyze, burn, and freeze the target. Lowers the foe’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage.

draconicannihilation.name: Draconic Annihilation
draconicannihilation.desc: A devastating steel strike. Clears terrain if one is active. If no terrain is present, the move's power increases.

freelance.name: Freelance
freelance.desc: If the user's Sp. Atk is higher, they perform a heartfelt dance that lifts protecting moves. If the user's Attack is higher, they strike twice with a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

criticaloverride.name: Critical Override
criticaloverride.desc: Bypasses armor with a pinpoint system exploit. Always lands as a critical hit.

synapticfeedback.name: Synaptic Feedback
synapticfeedback.desc: Deals damage. If the target used a damaging move on the last turn, power doubles.

hatefulslash.name: Hateful Slash
hatefulslash.desc: The user enters in a furious state, stuck in a endless loop until it misses

solarflare.name: Solar Flare
solarflare.desc: The user gathers light on the first turn, then crashes into the target with radiant force on the next turn. This may also leave the target with a burn.

currenttackle.name: Current Tackle
currenttackle.desc: The user envelops in a current and tackles the enemy, the faster the user is against the foe, the harder it hits

hardboil.name: Hard-Boil
hardboil.desc: The user attacks the enemy with an egg that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally an egg that restores its HP instead.

flareball.name: Flare Ball
flareball.desc: The user concentrates a burst of flames, it gets stronger if the user has less than half Hp

horrormaw.name: Horror Maw
horrormaw.desc: The target is bitten by a giant set of jaws, this move traps the opponent. This move may cause flinching.

honeydew.name: Honeydew
honeydew.desc: The honey gathered is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more honey is gathered, the more HP is restored.

triplefury.name: Triple Fury
triplefury.desc: The user jabs the target three times in succession using its sharp beak. This move usually goes first. When used by Dodrio, sometimes all three heads will act in unison, doubling the move's power.

sirenssong.name: Siren's Song
sirenssong.desc: The user sings an enchanting melody, dealing damage and causing the target to fall asleep on the next turn. This move is both a Water and Fairy type move.

moondance.name: Moon Dance
moondance.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.

flarebomb.name: Flare Bomb
flarebomb.desc: Bomb move. 30% chance to burn the target.

interfere.name: Interfere
interfere.desc: The user unleashes a wave of ECM, harshly lowering the targets special attack stat, this deals quite a lot of recoil.

shockwaveslam.name: Shockwave Slam
shockwaveslam.desc: The user unleashes a thundering shockwave through the ground, dealing damage and lowering the target's Speed. This move is also a ground type move that hits all adjacent foes.

softserve.name: Soft Serve
softserve.desc: The user restores the HP of itself or an ally by up to half of the target's max HP.

invasion.name: Invasion
invasion.desc: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself. The user strikes immediately in void fog.

volcalithvolley.name: Volcalith Volley
volcalithvolley.desc: The user hurls searing hot slack at the target. This move continues to deal damage to opponents for four turns.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.desc: Surfing on a wave, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first in rain.

sharpsteel.name: Sharp Steel
sharpsteel.desc: The user lays a trap of sharp steel around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

drakeglide.name: Drake Glide
drakeglide.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

vengeanceofgenerations.name: Vengeance of Generations
vengeanceofgenerations.desc: The user attacks with the full force of a thousand generations. This move ignores the target's Ability and Immunities.

mountainpoint.name: Mountain Point
mountainpoint.desc: The user rams into the target at full force with a sharp horn, drill, or spike. This also damages the user a little.

torpedo.name: Torpedo
torpedo.desc: The user rotates rapidly and goes with extreme velocity to tackle the target, it always flinches. The user can’t move on the next turn.

splinteredaxe.name: Splintered Axe
splinteredaxe.desc: The user slashes the target with a splintered axe. If the target is knocked out by this move, it lays two layers of spikes.

deepfreeze.name: Deep Freeze
deepfreeze.desc: The user attacks by super-freezing the air around the target. This also leaves the target with frostbite.

silkspinout.name: Silk Spin-Out
silkspinout.desc: The user rapidly spins around, damages the target and leaves behind a trail of sticky webs.

cosmicray.name: Cosmic Ray
cosmicray.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

hypervoidstrike.name: Hypervoid Strike
hypervoidstrike.desc: The user unleashes a mighty blow of dark stellar energy. Even when the target protects itself, the sheer force of this move bypasses shields and deals damage.

flashbang.name: Flashbang
flashbang.desc: The user emits a powerful flash of light to inflict damage on everything around it. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

mindshift.name: Mind Shift
mindshift.desc: The user mentally reorganizes its power, moving half of its higher Attack or Sp. Atk stat to the other stat.

guardianbeam.name: Guardian Beam
guardianbeam.desc: The user attacks the target by shooting a mysterious beam out of its eye. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move, and this attack never misses.

bramblering.name: Bramble Ring
bramblering.desc: The user evelops itself in a veil of thorns. The thorns damage attackers that make direct contact, and lasts until the user switches out.

judgementslash.name: Judgement Slash
judgementslash.desc: The user delivers a divine steel sentence that strikes harder against foes hiding behind their defenses.

whiparound.name: Whip Around
whiparound.desc: The user whips around and spins to eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed before rushing back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

thunderofideals.name: Thunder of Ideals
thunderofideals.desc: Electric-type special move. 100 power. Sets Electric Terrain. 20% chance to paralyze the target and raises the user’s Speed by 1 stage.

spectralcall.name: Spectral Call
spectralcall.desc: The user calls for help of fellow Ghost-Types, increasing a random user stat for each

icetail.name: Ice Tail
icetail.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

braveclaw.name: Brave Claw
braveclaw.desc: The user puts all of its might into a slashing attack, giving the user a 10% chance to get their attack and speed boosted by 2 stages.

magictrick.name: Magic Trick
magictrick.desc: The user performs a magic trick to switch the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of itself or an ally.

daybreak.name: Daybreak
daybreak.desc: The user rises like the sun before striking the target with radiant light. When used in void fog, the user will lose some of its HP to change the weather to harsh sunlight. This move's power is boosted by 50% in harsh sunlight.

thermalrupture.name: Thermal Rupture
thermalrupture.desc: The user rapidly heats the target, breaking it apart, dealing physical damage. This move is super effective on Rock types.

fruitbearer.name: Fruitbearer
fruitbearer.desc: The user restores 50% of the damage dealt.

dealer.name: Dealer
dealer.desc: The user shuffles the items of every Pokémon, randomly giving each of them a new item amongst those on the field.

seismicwave.name: Seismic Wave
seismicwave.desc: The user shakes the ground with a seismic wave to attack the target. This move deals special damage.

witchwoodlure.name: Witchwood Lure
witchwoodlure.desc: The user whispers from its rooted perch, trapping the target and slowly draining its life force over several turns.

mochimania.name: Mochi Mania
mochimania.desc: The user forms a ball of edible mochi dough and hurls it at the target. If used on an ally, this move heals them by 50% of their maximum HP

crystalhammer.name: Crystal Hammer
crystalhammer.desc: The target is hammered with a large crystalline claw. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

mindbend.name: Mind Bend
mindbend.desc: The user attacks the target with mental fortitude. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals. This may also confuse the target.

databreaker.name: Data Breaker
databreaker.desc: If the target has any stat boosts, one is randomly reduced before dealing damage.

moonimpact.name: Moon Impact
moonimpact.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

apextailwhip.name: Apex Tail Whip
apextailwhip.desc: The apex version of Tail Whip. Deals 30 damage and lowers both the target's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

pamper.name: Pamper
pamper.desc: The user pampers itself to raise its stats. This move's effects vary depending on what trim the user has.

draconicvelocity.name: Draconic Velocity
draconicvelocity.desc: Strikes with blinding dragon speed. If it KOs the foe, Speed increases.

badinput.name: Bad Input
badinput.desc: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. The user distorts the fabric of reality, randomizing its type in the process.

stasisroom.name: Stasis Room
stasisroom.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon only take damage from attacks, and cannot recover HP for five turns.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.desc: Consumes HP to create Electric Terrain, boosting Special Attack, further increase if already in Electric Terrain.

superpunch.name: Super Punch
superpunch.desc: The user launches a powered punch with it's fist

starshot.name: Starshot
starshot.desc: The user attacks the target with a shooting star. This attack never misses.

voidstep.name: Void Step
voidstep.desc: The user steps through the void to attack the target. This move's power is boosted and always goes first in void fog.

sparechange.name: Spare Change
sparechange.desc: The user hurls a salvo of coins at the target, which hit 2-5 times.

triphasecannon.name: Tri-Phase Cannon
triphasecannon.desc: Fires three pulses. Each hit has a 20% chance to Confuse, Flinch, or lower Sp. Def.

quickfire.name: Quick-Fire
quickfire.desc: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

voidlash.name: Void Lash
voidlash.desc: The user lashes its whip-like body around to strike opposing Pokémon. This lowers the user's Speed stat, and may also confuse the target.

justinbeam.name: Justin Beam
justinbeam.desc: The user uses it's Justin powers to Justin blast the opponent with a Justin beam

trinitybreath.name: Trinity Breath
trinitybreath.desc: Changes to Dragon, Fire, Ice, or Electric depending on effectiveness.

feyhammer.name: Fey Hammer
feyhammer.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

sabercrush.name: Saber Crush
sabercrush.desc: The target is biten with extreme force. This may cause the target to flinch

sandshift.name: Sand Shift
sandshift.desc: The user shoots sand at the target before rushing to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

soulblade.name: Soul Blade
soulblade.desc: The user channels their soul into their blade and slashs at the opponent. This move ignores protection.

voltjolt.name: Volt Jolt
voltjolt.desc: The user quickly tackles and jolts the target. This move always goes first.

ironage.name: Iron Age
ironage.desc: A column of steel hits the target. It has a unique effect when used alongside Ice Age, Stone Age, Dragon Age, or Electric Age. The effect changes depending on which move its combined with.

injectionshot.name: Injection Shot
injectionshot.desc: The target is hit with multiple tentacle like needles. This move may inflict poison, burn, or paralysis.

venombinding.name: Venom Binding
venombinding.desc: The target is badly poisoned, and cannot flee or switch out.

backpetal.name: Backpetal
backpetal.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

bulletbarrage.name: Bullet Barrage
bulletbarrage.desc: The user forcefully shoots metal bullets at the target two to five times in a row.

terminalvelocity.name: Terminal Velocity
terminalvelocity.desc: The user attacks by crashing into the target at mach speed. The higher the user's Speed, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

steelburstcrash.name: Steelburst Crash
steelburstcrash.desc: A brutal metallic crash that bypasses defensive barriers. Deals recoil.

lunarblade.name: Lunar Blade
lunarblade.desc: The user gathers moonlight on the first turn, then fills a blade with the moon's energy and attacks on the next turn. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

dragonage.name: Dragon Age
dragonage.desc: A column of dragon energy hits the target. It has a unique effect when used alongside Ice Age, Iron Age, Stone Age, or Electric Age. The effect changes depending on which move its combined with.

midastouch.name: Mida's Touch
midastouch.desc: The user touches the target, giving them a coat of gold and giving them the Steel-Type

demolish.name: Demolish
demolish.desc: The user charges with unstoppable force, shattering barriers like brittle stone. If the target was protected, that move is disabled.

spiraldrain.name: Spiral Drain
spiraldrain.desc: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

daybreakcannon.name: Daybreak Cannon
daybreakcannon.desc: The user calls upon the Sun for help, making the user launch a powerful blast from their body that has a high chance to burn foes. The user can't move on the next turn unless used in harsh Sunlight.

infernalcry.name: Infernal Cry
infernalcry.desc: Sets Sunny Day and Electric Terrain. 30% chance to freeze

meteorforce.name: Meteor Force
meteorforce.desc: The user crushes the target with an unseen force. This move's power is boosted by 50% when Gravity is active. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

wujiannihilation.name: Wuji Annihilation
wujiannihilation.desc: 70% OHKO all foes. Miss = lose 50% HP & -2 all stats.

phantomtrick.name: Phantom Trick
phantomtrick.desc: The user performs a ghostly trick to switch the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of itself or an ally.

wickedwish.name: Wicked Wish
wickedwish.desc: The target is hit with a status from a wicked wish. this move will always inflict burn, freeze, or poison but only ever one status.

sparklingmist.name: Sparkling Mist
sparklingmist.desc: The user exudes a beautiful but intoxicating mist that affects the surrounding opponents. This move may inflict poison or sleep.

starburst.name: Starburst
starburst.desc: The user unleashes a colorful salvo of meteor fragments, that damages all Pokémon of the opponent's side.

snowbank.name: Snow Bank
snowbank.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in snow or hail, but less HP in harsh sunlight.

stickybubble.name: Sticky Bubble
stickybubble.desc: The user throws a glob of sticky froables at the target. This lowers the target's Speed stat and prevents them from switching out.

crystalspear.name: Crystal Spear
crystalspear.desc: The user pierces the target with a crystalline spear. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and never misses.

spiritsong.name: Spirit Song
spiritsong.desc: The user belts out an ancient song to lift the spirits of the past. This causes sleeping Pokémon to wake up.

electronshot.name: Electron Shot
electronshot.desc: Shoots a small blast fully charged of Electrons

vinepress.name: Vine Press
vinepress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its plant-like body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

assaultbarrage.name: Assault Barrage
assaultbarrage.desc: Hits two to five times in one turn.

galeburst.name: Gale Burst
galeburst.desc: The user concentrates a burst of wind, it gets stronger if the user has less than half Hp

hyberburst.name: Hyber Burst
hyberburst.desc: A powerful attack exclusive to hybrid Pokémon and uses their primary typing. After use, the user must recharge for two turns.

metalstorm.name: Metal Storm
metalstorm.desc: The user unleashes a storm of metallic shards, striking the target 2-5 times. This move has a chance to lower the target's Special Defense with each hit.

phaseshift.name: Phase Shift
phaseshift.desc: The user senses the target's movements and strikes before teleporting out of danger. The user switches places with another party Pokémon. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

snowrush.name: Snow Rush
snowrush.desc: The user rushes towards the target with break neck speeds, the damage of this move is based on the users speed stat.

lethalinjection.name: Lethal Injection
lethalinjection.desc: The user jabs the target and injects them with a liquid that reacts when it comes into contact with poisonous substances. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned. This move is also super effective on Poison types.

powerblast.name: Power Blast
powerblast.desc: The user attacks the target by shooting a powerful blast of energy. The recoil from this move also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

fellowisp.name: Fell-O-Wisp
fellowisp.desc: The user unleashes a cruel swarm of blue soul-flames that attack with whichever power is stronger, physical or spiritual. May burn the target.

venting.name: Venting
venting.desc: The user hops into a vent, confusing the target before switching places with an ally in waiting.

gaiahorn.name: Gaia Horn
gaiahorn.desc: The user strikes the target with antlers imbued by nature's power. This move's effects change depending on the weather.

livewire.name: Live Wire
livewire.desc: The user lays a trap of electrical wires at the feet of the opposing team. The wires will paralyze opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

neodestructionpulse.name: Neo Destruction Pulse
neodestructionpulse.desc: Hits all adjacent foes. May lower their Special Defense.

soulblaze.name: Soul Blaze
soulblaze.desc: The user fires a wisp that burns the target's soul. The move deals both Ghost and Fire type damage.

echoshards.name: Echo Shards
echoshards.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating echo shards around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

meteorstrike.name: Meteor Strike
meteorstrike.desc: The user crashes into the target from above. If the attack misses, the user hurts itself. When Gravity is active, this move doubles in power but the user will hurt itself even when the attack hits.

faetrickery.name: Fae Trickery
faetrickery.desc: An illusion inducing fae dance that distorts the foe’s senses while enhancing the user's own clarity and speed. May confuse either combatant.

zapkick.name: Zap Kick
zapkick.desc: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

distortionroom.name: Distortion Room
distortionroom.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which type effectiveness is reversed for five turns. Ghost-type Pokémon do not have their type effectiveness reversed.

tradeoff.name: Trade Off
tradeoff.desc: the user trades both items of his and the target to a random held item

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.desc: The user recklessly charges at the target, tearing up the battlefield in the process. This damages the user quite a lot and destroys room field effects.

sugarrush.name: Sugar Rush
sugarrush.desc: The user cutely runs over the target with overwhelming speed and sweetness. This move usually goes first.

justinpunch.name: Justin Punch
justinpunch.desc: The user uses it's Justin powers to Justin blast the opponent with some Justin punch

magicbeam.name: Magic Beam
magicbeam.desc: The user shoots the target with a magical beam. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

implosion.name: Implosion
implosion.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing a implosion. The user faints upon using this move.

starflight.name: Star Flight
starflight.desc: The user nimbly glides around the target, showering them with stardust. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

parry.name: Parry
parry.desc: The user reacts to the target's movement and counters with a sharp blade, making the target flinch and always resulting in a critical hit. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

disastrousaura.name: Disastrous Aura
disastrousaura.desc: The user unleashes its draconic energy into a destructive wave of aura. This may also lower the opponents' SpDef.

peerlessedge.name: Peerless Edge
peerlessedge.desc: The user strikes the target with a heavy sword. The more defeated foes there are in the target's party, the greater the move's power.

gyrosphere.name: Gyro Sphere
gyrosphere.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

voidfog.name: Void Fog
voidfog.desc: The user blots out the sky by creating a thick black fog. This fog prevents the use of light moves, prevents Dark-type Pokémon from having their stats lowered, and boosts the defense of Psychic-type Pokémon.

generationdance.name: Generation Dance
generationdance.desc: The user performs the dance of its ancestors, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in harsh sunlight.

brutalspin.name: Brutal Spin
brutalspin.desc: Frees the user from hazards, binding and Leech Seed.

slimeball.name: Slime Ball
slimeball.desc: The user throws a ball of slime at the target. If the user has any slime layers, this attack lowers the target's Speed stat. This moves power increases depending on how many layers of slime the user has.

flamecloak.name: Flame Cloak
flamecloak.desc: The user cloaks itself in flames, it raises both Atk and Spa, if a foe hit the user while the cloak is active it get burned

clearcoat.name: Clear Coat
clearcoat.desc: The user shrouds it's frame in a clear coating. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

bombardment.name: Bombardment
bombardment.desc: The user fires 2 stone rockets at the target, this may decrease the targets defence.

clothosgift.name: Clotho's Gift
clothosgift.desc: The user weaves a shining thread of life, restoring HP to all allies by 25% of their maximum HP.

pitfall.name: Pitfall
pitfall.desc: The user creates a pitfall to trip the target. This move enables the user to attack first, but fails if the target is not readying an attack.

relicdance.name: Relic Dance
relicdance.desc: The user performs an ancient dance. This raises the user's Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats and also changes Meloetta's form.

stasisbeam.name: Stasis Beam
stasisbeam.desc: The user attacks the target with halting beam. The target becomes locked in stasis and this move's power is boosted by 50% when Stasis Room is active.

gnaw.name: Gnaw
gnaw.desc: Bite move. 20% chance to flinch the target.

laserbeam.name: Laser Beam
laserbeam.desc: The user concentrates their energy into a laser, the type of the move varies with the user, this may also burn the target

pyroshield.name: Pyro Shield
pyroshield.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks, burning those who make contact. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

butterflylanding.name: Butterfly Landing
butterflylanding.desc: The user delicately lands on the ground to rest its wings. After using this move, the user will no longer be Flying type and their moves will have an increased likelihood of additional effects occuring.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: The user snuffs makes a wide swipe its blade toward opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.desc: The user fires a beam of moonlight at the target to inflict damage. This move's power is boosted by 50% in void fog, and may also leave the target drowsy.

terrainblade.name: Terrain Blade
terrainblade.desc: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

laststand.name: Last Stand
laststand.desc: The user makes their final stand, boosting their speed and sharply boosting their Attack and Sp. Atk. This prevents the user from switching out for fleeing.

fossilfang.name: Fossil Fang
fossilfang.desc: The user bites into the target with sharp rock-like fangs. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

eeriepulse.name: Eerie Pulse
eeriepulse.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

savorysoup.name: Savory Soup
savorysoup.desc: Fully restores the HP of all Pokémon on the field, except the user. Opposing Pokémon also have their Attack lowered by two stages.

punch.name: Punch
punch.desc: The user punches the target with it's fists

cargothrow.name: Cargo Throw
cargothrow.desc: The user attacks by grabbing the target with one of its arms, making the target unable to flee. If used against a target that has already been grabbed, the target is thrown and a different Pokémon is dragged out.

latentpower.name: Latent Power
latentpower.desc: 20% chance to raise a random stat of the user by 1.

obliquekick.name: Oblique Kick
obliquekick.desc: The user stomps down on the opponent's knee. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

malevolentmight.name: Malevolent Might
malevolentmight.desc: The user releases all of its might onto the target. Will burn the target.

psychicsnap.name: Psychic Snap
psychicsnap.desc: The user sends out a shockwave of psychic power capable of shattering glass. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

fullthrottle.name: Full Throttle
fullthrottle.desc: The user slams into the target at full force. This move can't be used twice in a row.

toxinshock.name: Toxin Shock
toxinshock.desc: The target is blasted with a intense shock and a wave of poison. This move may inflict poison as well as raising the users Sp. Atk by one stage.

tigerbridge.name: Tiger Bridge
tigerbridge.desc: The user grabs the target and performs a reckless backbreaker rack drop. This also damages the user a little.

leviathanpulse.name: Leviathan Pulse
leviathanpulse.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by shooting twin pulses of condensed water. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

befuddle.name: Befuddle
befuddle.desc: The user flaps its colorful wings and emits a strange wave of energy. This may confuse the target.

rehearsal.name: Rehearsal
rehearsal.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.

icecannon.name: Ice Cannon
icecannon.desc: The user launches ice from it's cannons, dealing twice the amount of damage to frozen targets

victorysear.name: Victory Sear
victorysear.desc: The target is attacked by searing flames. High chance to burn.

marinelight.name: Marine Light
marinelight.desc: The user shines an eerie hypnotic light at the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

digdeep.name: Dig Deep
digdeep.desc: The user digs into the target using its body as a pickaxe. This move is super effective on Ground-type Pokémon.

armycall.name: Army Call
armycall.desc: The user roars to battle with his fellow Fighting-Types, increasing a random user stat for each

hyperstellarburst.name: Hyperstellar Burst
hyperstellarburst.desc: An energy explosion of pure cosmic power is fired at the target. Even if the target protects itself, the sheer force of this move bypasses shields and deals damage.

papercut.name: Paper Cut
papercut.desc: The user attacks by slicing the target with a blade as thin as paper. This move always lands a critical hit.

viralfang.name: Viral Fang
viralfang.desc: The user bites down on the target, giving the opponent a 35% chance to be poisoned and having their speed, defense, and special defense lowered by one stage.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks and increasing one defensive stat. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

starpower.name: Star Power
starpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain and void fog. This also restores the user's HP one turn after the move is used.

flurrypower.name: Flurry Power
flurrypower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain and snow or hail. This also leaves the target with frostbite.

voidpower.name: Void Power
voidpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from void fog. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

grasspower.name: Grass Power
grasspower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

brainpower.name: Brain Power
brainpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain and rain. This also confuses the target.

wildpower.name: Wild Power
wildpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from its surroundings. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

fogpower.name: Fog Power
fogpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain and rain. This also lowers the target's accuracy.

rainpower.name: Rain Power
rainpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from rain. This also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

mistpower.name: Mist Power
mistpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

stormpower.name: Storm Power
stormpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain and rain. This also causes the user to become charged.

shadowpower.name: Shadow Power
shadowpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain and void fog. This also torments the target.

staticpower.name: Static Power
staticpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain and sandstorms. This also leaves the target paralyzed.

conductivepower.name: Conductive Power
conductivepower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain and snow or hail. This superconducts the opposing team, causing them to take increased damage for 4 turns.

psychicpower.name: Psychic Power
psychicpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain. This also raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.

lunarpower.name: Lunar Power
lunarpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain and void fog. This also leaves the target drowsy.

crystalpower.name: Crystal Power
crystalpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain and sandstorms. This also causes pointed stones to float around the target.

swamppower.name: Swamp Power
swamppower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain and rain. This also creates a swamp to lower the Speed stats of the opposing side.

solarpower.name: Solar Power
solarpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain and harsh sunlight. This also causes the user to focus their energy, increasing their chance of landing a critical hit.

astralpower.name: Astral Power
astralpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain and harsh sunlight. This also sets Reflect to weaken the power of opposing Pokémon's physical moves.

snowpower.name: Snow Power
snowpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from snow or hail. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

electricpower.name: Electric Power
electricpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Electric Terrain. This also raises the user's Speed stat.

relicpower.name: Relic Power
relicpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain and sandstorms. This also causes the target to float, making them easier to hit for three turns.

ruinouspower.name: Ruinous Power
ruinouspower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain and void fog. This also leaves the target badly poisoned.

winterpower.name: Winter Power
winterpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain and snow or hail. This also causes ice spikes to float around the target.

aurorapower.name: Aurora Power
aurorapower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Psychic Terrain and snow or hail. This also sets Light Screen to weaken the power of opposing Pokémon's special moves.

frontierpower.name: Frontier Power
frontierpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain and sandstorms. This also scatters spikes under the target.

steampower.name: Steam Power
steampower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Misty Terrain and harsh sunlight. This also leaves the target with a burn.

springpower.name: Spring Power
springpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from Grassy Terrain and harsh sunlight. This also creates a sea of fire to damage the opposing side at the end of each turn.

sandpower.name: Sand Power
sandpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from sandstorms. This also raises the user's Defense stat.

sunpower.name: Sun Power
sunpower.desc: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects come from harsh sunlight. This also raises the user's Attack stat.

commandment.name: Commandment
commandment.desc: The user commands multiple Gastly. These can either heal the user, boost both its defenses or raise its special attack and critical hit ratio.

crystalbarrier.name: Crystal Barrier
crystalbarrier.desc: The user reinforces the crystals on its body, increasing defense but lower speed.

shadowblast.name: Shadow Blast
shadowblast.desc: A wicked blade of air is formed using a shadowy aura.

maxprism.name: Max Prism
maxprism.desc: This is a Crystal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Defensive stats.

shadowstorm.name: Shadow Storm
shadowstorm.desc: A shadowy aura is used to whip up a vicious tornado.

unstablesurge.name: Unstable Surge
unstablesurge.desc: The user overloads itself unleashing intense energy. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

maxvoid.name: Max Void
maxvoid.desc: This is a Shadow-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This boosts ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

multilick.name: Multi Lick
multilick.desc: The user commands 5 Gastly to attack the target. This move hits 5 times and deals physical damage.

shadowshed.name: Shadow Shed
shadowshed.desc: A shadowy aura eliminates barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen while lowering their evasiveness.

crystallineoverload.name: Crystalline Overload
crystallineoverload.desc: The user focuses intense beams of light into a powerful steam of energy. This also lowers the users special attack a lot.

kaijucataclysm.name: Kaiju Cataclysm
kaijucataclysm.desc: Hits 5 times, guaranteed to land critical hits, and bypasses substitute and abilities

crystalcannon.name: Crystal Cannon
crystalcannon.desc: The user focuses light hitting its crystals and releases it at once. This may also burn the target.

shinyglare.name: Shiny Glare
shinyglare.desc: The user imposes the target with shiny gemstones. The target becomes unable to flee.

shadowdown.name: Shadow Down
shadowdown.desc: A shadowy aura sharply cuts the foe's Defense.

crystalveil.name: Crystal Veil
crystalveil.desc: The user blinds the target with a veil of light cast by its crystals. Lowers the targets accuracy.

shardstrike.name: Shard Strike
shardstrike.desc: The user hits the target with sharp shards of gems.

glintingbeam.name: Glinting Beam
glintingbeam.desc: A colorful Beam of prismatic Energy.

soulleech.name: Soul Leech
soulleech.desc: The user grabs onto the soul of the target, trapping it and stealing some HP every turn.

blackvortex.name: Black Vortex
blackvortex.desc: A powerful Vortex made of Shadows.

whitealbum.name: White Album
whitealbum.desc: Compares the Attack and Special Attack stats,  dealing damage with whichever is higher against the opponent.
